why_it_passes: The project has rulings, but none covers spending money on a second server; the card is a clear decision with costs.

card.title: Pay $30 a month for a backup server?
card.context: All clinic data sits on one server. If it breaks, clinics cannot book patients until it is rebuilt, which took six hours last time. A second server that takes over by itself costs $30 a month, and the agent that runs our hosting can set it up today.
card.question: Should the agent add a backup server for $30 a month?

choices.label: Yes, add it
choices.pros: a broken server costs clinics minutes, not hours

choices.label: No
choices.cons: a broken server stops bookings for hours again

card.why: Six hours without bookings costs clinics far more than $30 a month.

rulings.name: merge-after-green
rulings.text: An agent merges its own pull request once a separate review agent has signed off and the required checks are green. The owners never review or merge pull requests themselves.

rulings.name: no-weekend-deploys
rulings.text: Nothing is released to customers between Friday 6 pm and Monday 8 am, whoever asks.
